anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: Before rejected the course model outright: it rendered a fix/review menu, treated the numeric 2 as ambiguous and asked a clarifying question (f1 fails), set the poll deadline once at 12:17 with no own-push renewal (f2 fails), stopped at BEHIND for a separate merge-base/update-branch decision so no sync or 4444 head ever existed (f3 fails), omitted the authorized in-progress re-run in C and wrote a flat 'no re-run' (f5 ambiguous/fails), and in D labelled remote A as 'lease / pre_head' with B only as an informal restore point, so pre_head was not B (f6 fails). After delivers the Change cleanly: numeric 2 persists course deliver and 10/10 caps before writes, both waves run without an intermediate menu, the table shows 12:17/12:25/12:27 with the 12:11 base-only observation explicitly not renewing, BEHIND queues a loop sync with separate syncs_used accounting, the final menu offers merge but stop is picked with no merge/approval, B exits stuck on red-twice with the base sync named as non-source movement, C admits the watch with CI P1 open during the one authorized re-run and reaches final at 0/0 with no extra dispatch, and D persists pre_head B / expected_remote_head A, leases against A, and resets to clean B with no second push. Nothing Before kept was lost (f4 stays holds). To keep this robust, consider stating in C's table that 'the one authorized re-run' is the only re-run requested (no earlier one), and in D state 'persisted before rebase' next to both heads rather than only in the syncs_used row, so a reader checking ordering finds it in one place.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After delivers the course model well: the single numeric 2 starts deliver, P1/P2 flow through without a mid-menu, BEHIND syncs automatically, final offers merge without executing it, B exits on the repeated-red rule, C watches the in-progress re-run and resolves P1, and D persists pre_head B / expected_remote_head A, leases against A, and restores B. The one miss is f2: After ties the deadline to the first watch rather than to own pushes, leaving the 12:02 push at `null` ('No watch has started, so no deadline exists yet') and showing 12:10 as 'null, then 12:25' as if the watch initialized it. The Change says timeout renews only on own push, so the wording should state that every own push stamps poll_deadline = push time + 15 minutes regardless of whether a watch has begun: 12:02→12:17, 12:10→12:25, 12:12→12:27, with the 12:11 base-only observation leaving 12:25 unchanged. Keep the rest of After as is; nothing Before held was lost (Before's B happened to state the base-sync-is-not-a-source-commit point, and After keeps it).
